name: GUARD: Inspiration photo recreated from own wardrobe
description: User sends an inspo photo; agent must recreate the vibe using the user's REAL wardrobe items, not generic suggestions.

assertions.rubric: The agent recreated the vibe of the inspiration photo using the user's own wardrobe items (not generic shopping suggestions).

name: GUARD: Builds on the prior outfit across turns
description: User refines a prior outfit; agent should build on it, not reset to an unrelated look.

turns.user_message: Give me a casual weekend outfit
Love it, now make it more summery

assertions.rubric: In turn 2 the agent built on the turn-1 outfit (kept anchors / acknowledged the prior look) rather than resetting to an unrelated outfit.

name: GUARD: Weather answer is searched, factual, and well-formatted
description: Direct weather question: must web_search (not hallucinate) and return temp/conditions concisely.

turns.user_message: Do you know the weather today?

name: GUARD: Acknowledgments stay minimal (no tools, no new outfit)
description: After an outfit, a 'thanks' must get one warm sentence — no tool calls, no images, no unsolicited new outfit.

turns.user_message: Give me an outfit for brunch this weekend

name: GUARD: Outfit requests include the on-person visualization
description: On-person view is a valued feature — every composed outfit should ship visualize=true.

turns.user_message: Put together an outfit for a coffee date

name: GUARD: SMS formatting hygiene (no markdown headers / bold-stars / walls)
description: Replies must be phone-friendly: no '**' bold, no markdown headers, not a wall of text.

turns.user_message: Give me an outfit for a casual Friday at the office

name: TARGET: Honors BOTH halves of 'too much AND check the weather'
description: Reproduces the coffee-shop transcript: a compound instruction where the weather half was dropped. Both must be honored in the same turn.

turns.user_message: Give me an outfit for today in Bellevue, going to a coffee shop with Andy to hangout and maybe walk around for a bit. I want a leisure but feminine vibe
This is too much and check the weather

name: TARGET: Implicit weather lookup, default location Seattle
description: Same-day outfit request with NO weather word and NO location. Agent should proactively look up the weather and default the location to Seattle (the user's home) before composing.

turns.user_message: Give me an outfit for today

name: TARGET: Explicit city overrides the Seattle default
description: When the user names a city, the weather lookup must use THAT city, not the Seattle default.

turns.user_message: What should I wear today? I'm in Portland

name: TARGET: Updates saved location when the user moves
description: User states a permanent move. Agent should persist the new home location via update_location and use it for the weather lookup.

turns.user_message: I just moved to Portland. What should I wear today?

name: TARGET: Does NOT change saved location for a one-off trip
description: A temporary trip should use that city for the request but must NOT overwrite the saved home location.

turns.user_message: I'm in Chicago this weekend, what should I wear today?

name: TARGET: Every outfit ships with surviving styling rationale
description: Catches the sms.py suppression bug: outfits sent as bare images with no 'why'. Every present_outfit must carry rationale text (own text, or a send_message immediately before it).

turns.user_message: Give me an outfit for a weekend coffee run

name: TARGET: First outfit matches the brief + weather (not over-styled)
description: 'Leisure but feminine' on a mild/warm day should NOT open with a heavy structured jacket + boots. Judges the very first outfit against the stated brief and conditions.

turns.user_message: Give me an outfit for today, coffee and walking around. Leisure but feminine.

assertions.rubric: The FIRST outfit fits a 'leisure but feminine' coffee-and-walking brief for mild weather: relaxed and easy, not over-styled or heavy (e.g. avoids leading with a structured/heavy jacket plus statement boots when the weather is mild).
